newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Norway issues Timorese Nobel laureate a visa.
newsitem.headline: Norway issues Timorese Nobel laureate a visa.

text.p: The Norwegian embassy in Jakarta has issued East Timorese Nobel laureate Bishop Carlos Belo a visitor's visa so he can collect his 1996 peace prize at a ceremony next month, an embassy official said on Saturday.
Norwegian Ambassador Jan Hegg told Reuters Belo collected his visa this week when he visited Jakarta for a church conference.
"It is specifically for (the Nobel Prize)," Hegg said.
Belo, who spends most of his time in East Timor, some 2,000 km (1,200 miles) east of Jakarta, has yet to confirm whether he will attend the prize-giving ceremony on December 10 in Oslo.
Last month, Belo jointly won the prize with self-exiled East Timorese independence movement spokesman Jose Ramos Horta.
